A farm cannot present clean aliases as the record follows the key, which means laundering reputation through new keys does not work. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 49 times over for the same share of the pool. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
